$about.what: EYES and EYE_BASE as the page holds them, and the geometry eyesPath() and eyeD() build from them. Per-state targets are in states.json.
$about.exported: 2026-11-13, Look Demo v5, Playwright (playwright-core 1.63.0) with Chrome 157 headless, 1440 x 900 viewport, deviceScaleFactor 2; values read from the page's own constants and functions at runtime

params.ht: top height above the centre line, in eye units
params.hb: bottom height below the centre line; negative makes a crescent (the happy arc)
params.kt: roundness of the top half (0.55 is close to an ellipse)
params.lid: upper lid, 0 open to 1 closed; it lowers the top and flattens it
params.rot: tilt in degrees, mirrored per eye (added by eyeTargets)
params.bright: opacity of the eyes group; the visor glow follows at 0.8 x (added by eyeTargets)
params.gy: resting vertical gaze, -1 up to 1 down (added by eyeTargets)

geometry.unit: 0.17 x visor height (eyeUnit per shape in shapes.json)
geometry.centres: x = vx + vw x (0.5 - 0.2) and vx + vw x (0.5 + 0.2); y = vy + vh / 2
geometry.gaze: gaze gx, gy in -1..1 move both centres by gx x 0.18 x vw and gy x 0.12 x vh; the eye on the side of the gaze grows by 8% x |gx|, the other shrinks by 6% x |gx|, both get 10% x |gx| narrower; a downward gaze lowers the lid to at least 0.25 x gy
geometry.blink: openness 0..1.04 scales the heights and moves the centre down by 0.25 x (1 - openness) x ht; widths grow by up to 6% while closed
geometry.contour: four cubic curves through the left, top, right and bottom points; the bottom never rises above -0.8 x the top (a crescent cannot invert)
geometry.stroke: fill and stroke in the eye color; stroke width 0.25 x vh x 0.17 (a quarter of the eye unit); the contour is inset by half of s = 0.25 x w x unit (the stroke width when w = 1), so a zero-height eye draws as a clean capsule line
geometry.glow: a second copy of the path with stroke width 2.6 at opacity 0.2, and a radial glow on the visor (rx 0.42 x vw, ry 0.5 x vh) in the eye color from opacity 0.55 to 0
geometry.color: eye color = mix(body, white, 0.62); Wally (coral) uses #FF7A5E (colors.json derived.byColor.*.eye)
